snippet.title: Stockroom Syndrome - Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The FREE DEMO for Stockroom Syndrome is OUT NOW on Steam.

Stockroom Syndrome is a PSX-inspired workplace horror game where you build flatpack furniture and furnish showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store -  while supernatural creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls.

Play the free demo now and wishlist Stockroom Syndrome on Steam. It genuinely makes a massive difference for an indie game like this and it would make my day/life.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5126990/Stockroom_Syndrome/

Official website: https://www.stockroom-syndrome.com/

HØLM.
Build the room. Survive the store.

Developed by HuffingtonPants.

#StockroomSyndrome #IndieHorror #PSXHorror #HorrorGames #IndieGame #WorkplaceHorror #SteamDemo #GameDev
